_comment: Data-source configuration for the MUR web viewer (dataviewer/web_viewer.py).
Copy to viewer.json next to run_web_viewer.py, or point MUR_VIEWER_CONFIG at it.
Precedence: environment variables beat this file, which beats the defaults.
The file is what you check in or bake into an image; the environment is what
Pointing MUR_VIEWER_CONFIG at a pipeline config (config.maap.json) also works:
the viewer reads maap.workspace_root out of it, so the workspace root does not
_run_source: Where the granule you are inspecting comes from: 'local' (a directory tree on the machine running Streamlit) or 'maap' (runs this pipeline published to MAAP's STAC).
_base_dir: Root of the local file browser, when run_source is 'local'. Also settable with MUR_BASE_DIR, which is what run_web_viewer.py has always used.
_reference_source: What Compare mode measures a run against: 'public' (the operational MUR L4 at PO.DAAC), 'local', or 'maap'. 'public' is the default because it is the same product this pipeline reproduces, so a difference against it is a statement about the run rather than about two files that happened to be on disk. The reference is matched on the run's own analysis date; no path selection is involved.
_public_collection: CMR short name for the public product. Downloading needs an Earthdata login (a urs.earthdata.nasa.gov entry in ~/.netrc, or EARTHDATA_USERNAME / EARTHDATA_PASSWORD); searching does not.
_maap_collection: Matches mur_maap/stac.py's DEFAULT_COLLECTION -- the collection run_mur_maap.py publishes L4 Items into.
_maap_workspace_root: s3://bucket/prefix. Fallback discovery: the viewer reads the STAC items the pipeline writes to mur/stac/items/<year>/ (mur_maap/paths.stac_item_key) directly out of the bucket when the STAC API is unset or unreachable. That route works today, before any STAC endpoint exists to point at. Needs s3fs.
_cache_dir: Where remote granules are materialized; defaults to ~/.cache/mur-viewer/granules. Every reader opens a local path, so a MAAP or PO.DAAC granule is downloaded once and reused. Namespaced by source, because our output and PO.DAAC's share a filename.
_max_download_mb: Refuse a single granule larger than this. MUR L4 is ~700 MB/day.
